goal: Speed up balance checking and coin selection for wallets with extensive transaction histories
Avoid iterating through every historical spent or conflicted output the wallet has ever owned
reviewability: Worth reviewing now with no known blockers invalidating review
agreement: Broad interest and benchmarks showing massive speedups on large wallets (remyers, w0xlt, Zeegaths)
Code approved after earlier cache synchronization bugs were resolved (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objections on reorg balance loss, pruned funds assertions, and fuzz crashes (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: wallet records are rewritten before load success is verified (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it massively accelerates balance calculation and coin selection for high-activity wallets
Wallets with large histories see speedups ranging from 31% up to hundreds of times faster
